title: How to Find High-Profit Products for Amazon FBA
content:
The biggest mistake new Amazon FBA sellers make is choosing products they like rather than products that sell. Product research is the single most important step of your business.

Here is the exact blueprint to find winning products.

The Golden Rules Checklist

Look for items that meet these specific metrics:

  • Retail Price between $20 - $50: This is the impulse-buy sweet spot. Anything cheaper has tiny profit margins, and anything more expensive makes customers hesitate.
  • Small and Lightweight: Aim for items under 2 lbs. Heavy or oversized items trigger high Amazon shipping fees that eat your profits.
  • Low Review Count: If the top 5 competitors all have over 5,000 reviews, it will be incredibly hard to rank on the first page. Look for niches where top sellers have under 300 reviews.
  • Consistent Year-Round Demand: Avoid seasonal items like Christmas lights or summer pool floats when you are starting out.

The Best Tools to Use

Do not guess the data. Use software to see exactly how much money a product makes every month:

  1. Jungle Scout: Excellent for checking monthly sales volume and tracking competitor history.
  2. Helium 10: The best tool for checking search volume keywords to see exactly what customers are typing into Amazon.

Find a boring, everyday item that fits these rules, improve the packaging or quality slightly, and you have a high chance of success.
